title: Synthetic Party Coordination and Mission Workflow
invariants: END_TURN_INTENDED is never treated as observed TURN_ENDED
New turn cannot begin before prior turn is confirmed ended
Every participant Ready does not prove fight start or turn ownership
Late confirmations checked even if no watchdog event occurs
Account generation, actor and fight epoch mismatch quarantined
First failure retained and later events cannot silently recover
Fight ended does not imply victory; separate outcome evidence required
Workflow consumes coordination contracts, not implementation internals
All reports permanently non-actionable; no physical input
limitations: All observations are synthetic; no authoritative live events
Timeouts are integer fixture ticks, not live wall-clock deadlines
Existing verify wrapper intermittently stalls in this environment; direct verbose suite passed
